messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-gateway-usw2 · metric=5xx_rate · window=1m · value=12.4% · threshold=5% · severity=high · link=https://pd/redwood/incidents/INC-1123
pagerduty: INC-1123 created and sent to rotation (primary=sam)
sam: Ack'd. I'm on it. Pulling charts and logs now :eyes:
lina: pinged — I'm available for routing/model fallback help if needed
raj: acking as backup. I'll check infra metrics (nodes, LB, kvcache)
sam: Quick summary from prometheus: error spike started 02:12 UTC, peak ~12% 5xx, 90th latency up 800ms. Traffic to inference-gateway rose ~3x from a single customer cluster.
raj: No node OOMs, CPU steady. KVCACHE eviction rate jumped ~4x; backend model-proxy returning 502s under fanout.
sam: Running targeted traffic-slice to reduce new connections to suspect pool: 
```
# route tool
re-route --service inference-gateway --slice suspect-pool --weight 0.15
```
ops-bot: Re-route job queued (job id: r7891). Estimated apply in 8s
sam: Re-route applied. Watching error-rate...
lina: Recommend applying model fallback to a smaller quantized variant while cache warms: model-x-quantized as temporary fallback
sam: Kicking fallback policy: set-model-fallback --service inference-gateway --from default-model --to model-x-quantized --weight 0.5
ops-bot: Model fallback update submitted (txn 0x4f3b)
pagerduty: Alert escalated to secondary oncall (raj) after 5m with no resolution
raj: Ack'd. I'll investigate LB connection resets and proxy logs. Noticing increased connection queue depth on proxy-03
sam: Customer impact: ~3% of served requests observe 502s and a higher retry rate; errors concentrated in the hosted-usw2 region; no data corruption reported. Notifying support for customer comms.
support-bot: Alert sent to #support: "502 spike in hosted-usw2 — customers may see increased retries; investigating."
raj: Tail of proxy logs shows upstream `504 gateway timeout` and `connection reset by peer` patterns around fanout bursts. Increasing upstream timeout for proxy-03 to 15s as temporary mitigation.
sam: Error-rate down to 2.1% 1m after re-route + fallback. Latency improving.
lina: Good. Plan for next steps: 1) keep fallback for 20m, 2) warm kv cache (increase shard prefill), 3) open infra ticket for autoscale tuning and cache sizing.
raj: I'll leave increased timeout and watch for any new spikes. Will also look at LB health checks to ensure no flapping.
sam: Preparing handoff note for night shift at 03:00 UTC: root cause likely sudden traffic fanout from a customer causing kvcache thrash and upstream proxy overload. Immediate mitigations: traffic slice, model fallback, increased proxy timeout. Suggested long-term actions: autoscale prefix burst policy, kvcache sizing, tighter client-side retry budget.
sam: Marking incident INC-1123 as mitigated — will resolve after 15m stable window. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: INC-1123 resolved by sam at 02:25 UTC
lina: Nice coordinated response. I'll file a post-incident ticket and add an eval to verify model-x-quantized output quality for the affected prompts.
raj: Added runbook note to infra: consider dynamic cache prefill for sudden customer fanouts.
sam: Thanks team — closing thread here. /end
